purpose: Freeze the acceptance semantics for one converged Trigger-2 semantic-Hyperposition positive-label gate before implementation or fresh positive-row generation. This is a convergence contract and test oracle, not a second semantic authority, dataset admission, or training execution.

authority_snapshot.owner_target: VARIABLE COGNITIVE GRID + PERSISTENT DATABASE + CLAUDE CODE + strongest causally evidenced Global J-Space bridge

observed_problem_statement.observation: The 11-row native seed v2 still self-checks through semantic_hyperposition_gate_v3, while the stronger registry-derived independence logic lives in a separate derivation_bound_gate_v2 path.

The retained chain does not bind event_id to an immutable digest over all semantically relevant event content, so coherent same-id event/registry mutation is not rejected as an identity collision at the strongest boundary.

A legitimate generator-path/hash binding does not by itself authenticate evaluator-only formal world and dependence-registry objects supplied inside a row. A coherent alternate world can be internally self-consistent while not being generated from the bound source/manifest.

Formal test definitions and pair-separation ordering exist, but resolution is not yet bound to typed discriminator admissibility, execution identity, outcome identity, decisiveness and live-alternative coverage receipts.
epistemic_guard still accepts a naked evidence_qualified_observation boolean for promotion to OBSERVED rather than a typed source-bound evidence receipt.
No exact-current repository-bound execution of the future converged gate/test chain is established by this preregistration.

single_authority_rule.law: There must be one retained positive-label candidate gate path. Structural/permutation checks, independence derivation, event/world provenance, discriminator proof closure and typed epistemic promotion may be implemented as internal helpers, but a candidate must not be able to choose a weaker parallel gate.
forbidden: artifact-name-based claims that a stronger gate ran
parallel positive-label authorities with overlapping semantics

event_identity_contract.digest_requirement: Compute a deterministic event_semantic_sha256 over a frozen canonical serialization of all required semantic fields. Non-authoritative convenience fields such as caller independence booleans must not alter the reference semantic digest or become label roots.
event_identity_contract.first_seen_binding: The first admitted evaluator identity for an event_id binds that event_id to exactly one event_semantic_sha256 inside the source/manifest-bound registry.
event_identity_contract.exact_replay_rule: same event_id + identical event_semantic_sha256 => idempotent replay; zero new independent evidence credit
event_identity_contract.collision_rule: same event_id + different event_semantic_sha256 => fail closed with EVENT_ID_CONTENT_COLLISION; never reinterpret as fresh evidence or silent replay
event_identity_contract.history_rule: Every E_plus/E_minus/F/correlated record used by the gate must be traceable to the same registry digest. A successor labeler may persist event_semantic_sha256 directly; otherwise the gate must reconstruct and verify it from complete stored semantic fields without ambiguity.

evaluator_world_provenance_contract.law: Exact labeler/generator file hashes are necessary but do not authenticate arbitrary evaluator objects carried by the row.
accepted_closure_options: reconstruct the formal world and event/dependence registry deterministically inside the gate from source-bound generator inputs
or require an immutable generation manifest that binds generator identity, generator inputs, formal_world_sha256, event_registry_sha256 and row/family identity, then recompute and compare all digests
must_reject: valid generator hash + coherently swapped formal world
valid generator hash + coherently swapped dependence registry
row/family identity not covered by the bound generation manifest

independence_contract.rule: Reference independent-evidence qualification is mechanically derived. Caller boolean mismatch is either rejected or overwritten before reference computation, but can never define the label.
independence_contract.goodman_boundary: New packaging, new event ids, model-family repackaging or duplicated execution ancestry do not create independent evidence when causal/provenance ancestry remains shared.

discriminator_receipt_contract.resolution_law: RESOLVED_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD is permitted only when every eliminated applicable live alternative is covered by admissible, executed, source-bound discriminator evidence and the survivor satisfies the reference support condition. A registered test, a ranked test, or a declared mismatch_effect alone is not execution evidence.
must_remain_unresolved: coverage omits any applicable live alternative required for the claimed resolution
decisiveness not sufficient for FALSIFIES semantics
receipt not bound to the same generation/source identity
discriminator_receipt_contract.scope_boundary: Synthetic/formal execution receipts establish only deterministic curriculum semantics. They do not mint provider, physical-runtime, canonical-world or whole-EntityOS evidence.

grf_epistemic_contract.law: UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS/COUNTERHYPOTHESIS/PREDICTION/CONTRADICTION/MEASUREMENT_ERROR -> OBSERVED cannot be authorized by a naked boolean.
grf_epistemic_contract.synthetic_boundary: Synthetic proof/measurement labels remain explicitly typed as synthetic curriculum semantics and cannot be confused with canonical-world observation.

labeler_and_carrier_invariants: full semantic Hyperposition carrier h_i=(v,K,E+,E-,F,T,A,sigma) remains explicit
projection is nondestructive and cannot delete unresolved branches
branch birth requires deterministic formal warrant
merge requires exact declared semantic equivalence, never embedding similarity or majority
branch id/order/permutation are nuisance unless semantics explicitly say otherwise
U/D/test-order/salience functions remain deterministic and non-probability-minting
salience is attention ordering only, never truth/evidence strength
synthetic task-local resolution remains type-distinct from canonical RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE
canonical truth and direct-effect authority remain false on all training candidates
acceptance_sequence: A0 source implementation matches this preregistered contract without weakening tests after observing failures
A1 exact unit/mutation matrix passes at bound source identity
A2 native seed successor imports exactly the retained gate and fails a deliberately constructed weaker-gate divergence case
A3 regenerated owner-target seed and D/E donors remain candidate-only and pass family/provenance split plus model-visible nuisance/conditional-MI gates
A4 exact-current execution is observed on an admitted FREE_ONLY surface with source/hash/receipt binding
A5 Forge/Distillery proves at least one evidence-qualified candidate packet can become accepted_dataset_tokens > 0 without bypassing independent admission
A6 only then may a small family-disjoint positive D/E pilot be considered for training admission; training execution itself remains separately authorized

counterhypotheses.claim: The separate semantic gate v3 and derivation-bound gate v2 are already equivalent enough for seed promotion.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: A row with caller-independent metadata or world/registry provenance mutation passes the semantic path while the preregistered single gate rejects it.

counterhypotheses.claim: Registry field equality is sufficient; event digest adds no information.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Coherently mutate event plus registry under the same event_id while preserving currently compared fields or the registry's self-consistency. If no immutable external/root binding detects it, identity is underconstrained.

counterhypotheses.claim: A formal test description is equivalent to discriminator execution.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Hold formal test metadata fixed while executed/admissible/coverage status changes. Resolution must change or remain blocked accordingly.

artifact_lifecycle_effects.successor_condition: binds the single preregistered successor gate and passes M17 plus the full relevant mutation subset
unique structural/permutation semantics fused into the single gate
registry-derived independence plus source binding fused with immutable event/world provenance and discriminator/GRF proof closure
full-cross or preregistered conditional-independence successor passes exact rendered nuisance gates

generation_decision.reason: V8 and the current provenance hard-negative blueprint already cover the observed failure families. Preregistering the exact successor acceptance boundary has higher information value and avoids duplicate training examples.

next_exact_action: Implement one single gate successor against this frozen mutation matrix, first closing evaluator-world/registry provenance and event-content identity before adding any positive rows; then rebind the native seed and observe exact-source tests.
